column1: # Compounds named in words rather than written as formulas (roadmap 1.2).
# "Sodium chloride" used to resolve as sodium plus chlorine, so "density of sodium chloride" was
# answered with sodium's density and "molar mass of calcium carbonate" as a comparison of calcium
# and carbon. A compound named in a question now claims its words before elements are looked for:
# it is answered where the app can say something true about it (formula, molar mass, composition,
# moles, solubility) and declined where it cannot (the app holds no compound properties).
# Guard rows at the end keep element questions that merely mention a compound working.
# expect_row, expect_value and known_failure are corpus format 2; see the shared README.
